# WMO document identifiers (pubid#763): the WMO-No. publication series
# and the WMO-published S-100 product specifications.
#
#   WMO-No. 1364                      publication, bare
#   WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition        publication, year edition (citation comma)
#   WMO-No. 1364 2025 edition         publication, year edition (cover stack)
#   WMO-No. 1364:ed2025               publication, compact year edition (alias)
#   S-411                             S-100 product specification, bare
#   S-411 1.2.1                       dotted edition (the S-411 repo form)
#   S-411:ed1.2.1                     compact dotted edition (alias)
#   S-411 Annex A                     annex wrapper (the DCEG docidentifier)
#   S-411 Annex A 1.2.0               annex wrapper carrying its edition
#
# Editions are a type-driven face: the WMO-No. series carries calendar-year
# editions ("2025 edition", MRN `ed2025`); the S-100 shapes carry the IHO
# dotted x.y.z (MRN `ed1.2.1`). Both bind the one `edition_value` capture;
# the builder keys the face off the resolved type.
#
# Type assignment (the #763 ruling): the S-lexical form is a WMO type,
# publisher-parameterised per IALA's S-201 — the lexical shape is the IHO
# S-100 form, but the flavor owns the WMO-published documents
# (metanorma/S-411-Product-Specification, mn-document-class wmo).
#
# Edition-2 conversion with typed model bindings, mirroring the iala
# grammar: each alternative path carries exactly one occurrence of every
# capture name, so the harvest delivers one flat bound map; the annex base
# composite stays unbound (its `doc_number` hoists to the top level) and
# the builder dispatches on `wmomarker` / `annex_marker`. The annex letter
# guard (!lower) keeps a following edition segment from mis-capturing.

grammar PubidWmo version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  wmomarker = "WMO-No." as wmomarker
  doc_number = (1*digit) as doc_number
  s_code = "S-" (1*digit) as doc_number
  year_value = (4digit) as edition_value
  dotted_value = (1*digit 1*(dot 1*digit)) as edition_value
  edition_year_human = ([comma] space year_value " edition") as edition
  edition_year_compact = (colon "ed" year_value) as edition
  edition_dotted_human = (space dotted_value) as edition
  edition_dotted_compact = (colon "ed" dotted_value) as edition
  annex_identifier = {
    s_code
    space
    ("Annex" / "ANNEX") as annex_marker
    [ (space upper as annex_letter !lower) ]
    [edition_dotted_human / edition_dotted_compact]
  }
  publication_identifier = {
    wmomarker space doc_number
    [edition_year_human / edition_year_compact]
  }
  standard_identifier = {
    s_code
    [edition_dotted_human / edition_dotted_compact]
  }
  identifier = annex_identifier / publication_identifier / standard_identifier
  entry identifier: identifier

  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  comma = ","
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  space = " "

  bindings identifier {
    wmomarker -> wmomarker (string)
    doc_number -> doc_number (string)
    edition_value -> edition_value (string)
    annex_marker -> annex_marker (string)
    annex_letter -> annex_letter (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "WMO-No. 1364"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364 2025 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364:ed2025"
    accept "S-411"
    accept "S-411 1.2.1"
    accept "S-411:ed1.2.1"
    accept "S-411 Annex A"
    accept "S-411 ANNEX A"
    accept "S-411 Annex A 1.2.0"
    reject "nonsense"
    reject "WMO-No. edition"
    reject "S-411 1234"
    example "WMO-No. 1364" { wmomarker: "WMO-No.", doc_number: "1364" }
    example "WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition" {
      wmomarker: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "1364",
      edition_value: "2025",
    }
    example "S-411 1.2.1" { doc_number: "411", edition_value: "1.2.1" }
    example "S-411 Annex A 1.2.0" {
      doc_number: "411",
      annex_marker: "Annex",
      annex_letter: "A",
      edition_value: "1.2.0",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 1364:ed2025" {
      wmomarker: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "1364",
      edition_value: "2025",
    }
  }
}
